title: Commit: feat(l2): define L2 ShivaCore Kernel & TCB contracts (Issue #137)
content:
feat(l2): define L2 ShivaCore Kernel & TCB contracts (Issue #137)

Catalog integration of the owner Sollarchitektur from Issue #137
(architecture_id ATC-LAYER-L2-SHIVACORE-KERNEL):

- Registry v0.4.0: L2 expanded to the 12 owner-specified sub-layers
  (L2.1 Kernel Core ... L2.12 Audit & Verification Hooks) with
  the capability-microkernel security model (least privilege, no
  ambient authority, isolation by default, explicit IPC,
  fail-closed) and kernel SSOT binding
  (globus-os/modules/atc-shivacore/kernel/) documented
- New ATC-L2-FUNCTION-CATALOG-001.yaml: all 75 function contracts
  (ATC-L2-KERN/CAP/MEM/SCHED/IPC/IRQ/ARCH/DEV/TCB/FAULT/ID/AUD)
  with full metadata schema incl. contract blocks, security model,
  and the fail-closed VERIFIED rule from the issue
- Implementation inventory at globus-os main 3bf0001
  (kernel SSOT directory, 45 source files):
  - 47 contracts IMPLEMENTED with inline test references and
    workspace suite evidence (1298/1298, exit 0 at exact SHA):
    capability attenuation/revocation (test_delegate_rejects_
    rights_expansion, test_kill_revokes_all_capabilities), VMM
    invariants (wx_is_rejected, kernel_high_half_cannot_be_user),
    page fault classification, deadline-aware scheduler,
    capability-checked IPC and syscall dispatch (unknown syscall,
    ABI mismatch, oversized payload rejected), fault isolation,
    SMP affinity, tracing ring buffer
  - 17 contracts MAPPED (source exists, test evidence
    unconfirmed): IDT/PIC init (no test region), SavedRegs/
    UserContext, GDT selectors, trust anchor model, LoadPolicy
  - 11 contracts UNRESOLVED with evidence-based reasons: no
    synchronization primitives, no shared-memory IPC grant, no
    DMA/IOMMU lifecycle (consistent with L0/L1), no TCB registry,
    no kernel panic contract, no test/prod interface separation
- Validator covers L0+L1+L2 function catalogs: 31/31 checks,
  0 errors, 0 warnings
- Architecture doc v0.4.0: L2 detail section added

Honesty rules preserved: no contract VERIFIED (CI evidence at
binding SHA pending); unproven contracts stay UNRESOLVED per
Issue #137 status model.
